# NOTES

# Tiles are recorded with 1 variable - value
# value_0_1: value at mine row 0 column 1
#   0-8 - uncovered with that many neighboring bombs
#   9 - bomb, uncovered & red
#   10 - bomb - uncovered in value and used as the regular bomb in comp
#   11 - flagged
#   12 - covered
#   13 - not in use (ex bottom-right tile when in beginner difficulty)

# ongoing game -- ms_game:
# 0 - no game
# 1 - game ongoing
# 2 - game lost

# difficulty:
# 0 - beginner - 9x9 with 10 mines
# 1 - intermediate - 16x16 with 40 mines
# 2 - expert - 30x16 with 99 mines

# Wrapper for difficulty switch
ms_difficulty_switch = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            var:difficulty = { compare_value = 0 }
        }
        $e1$ = yes
    } else_if = {
        limit = {
            var:difficulty = { compare_value = 1 }
        }
        $e2$ = yes
    } else = {
        $e3$ = yes
    }
}

# Scripted effect to initialize or reset the gamestate
ms_init_reset = {
    # End ongoing game
    set_variable = {
        name = ms_game
        value = 0
    }

    # Reset board based on difficulty
    ms_init_reset_hideall = yes
    ms_difficulty_switch = { e1 = ms_init_reset_beginner e2 = ms_init_reset_intermediate e3 = ms_init_reset_expert }

    # Set bomb count variables
    set_variable = { name = flagged value = 0 }
    ms_difficulty_switch = { e1 = ms_bombs_beginner e2 = ms_bombs_intermediate e3 = ms_bombs_expert }

    ms_recompute_visuals = yes
}

ms_lc = {
    #set_variable = { name = value_$r$_$c$ value = 1 }
    #remove_variable = show_$r$_$c$_12
    #set_variable = show_$r$_$c$_1

    # If there is an ongoing game - ms_game = 1 - regular left click
    # If there is no ongoing game - ms_game = 0 - start a new game
    # If a game was lost - ms_game = 2 - do nothing

    if = {
        limit = {
            var:ms_game = { compare_value = 0 }
        }
        ms_start_new_game = { r = $r$ c = $c$ }
    } else_if = {
        limit = {
            var:ms_game = { compare_value = 1 }
        }

        if = {   # clear cell
            limit = {
                var:value_$r$_$c$ = { compare_value = 12 }
            }
            # If comp r c is 10, game is lost
            # Otherwise, set value_r_c to comp_r_c

            if = {
                limit = {
                    var:comp_$r$_$c$ = { compare_value = 10 }
                }
                set_variable = { name = value_$r$_$c$ value = 9 }
                ms_lose_game = yes
            } else = {
                set_variable = { name = value_$r$_$c$ value = root.var:comp_$r$_$c$ }
                ms_propagate_uncover = yes
                ms_recompute_visuals = yes
                ms_check_victory = yes
            }
        } else_if = {   # chord
            limit = {
                AND = {
                    var:value_$r$_$c$ = { compare_value > 0 }
                    var:value_$r$_$c$ = { compare_value <= 8 }
                }
            }
            ms_chord = { r = $r$ c = $c$ }
            ms_check_victory = yes
        }
    }
}

ms_rc = {
    # Right click only does anything if there is an ongoing game
    if = {
        limit = {
            var:ms_game = { compare_value = 1 }
        }
        # Unflag
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:value_$r$_$c$ = { compare_value = 11 }
            }
            set_variable = { name = value_$r$_$c$ value = 12 }
            remove_variable = show_$r$_$c$_11
            set_variable = show_$r$_$c$_12
            change_variable = { name = flagged add = -1 }
        }
        # Flag
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                var:value_$r$_$c$ = { compare_value = 12 }
            }
            set_variable = { name = value_$r$_$c$ value = 11 }
            remove_variable = show_$r$_$c$_12
            set_variable = show_$r$_$c$_11
            change_variable = { name = flagged add = 1 }
        }
    }
    
}

ms_generate_board = {
    # step 1 - copy board over to comp -- this sets difficulty bounds
    ms_copy_value_to_comp = yes

    # step 2 - generate mines
    ms_difficulty_switch = { e1 = generate_mines_beginner e2 = generate_mines_intermediate e3 = generate_mines_expert }

    # step 3 - compute the numbers on comp
    ms_comp_compute = yes

    # set r, c to 12 and compute again because im lazy man
    set_variable = { name = comp_$r$_$c$ value = 12 } 
    ms_comp_compute = yes
}

generate_mines_intermediate = {
    while = {
        count = 40

        random_list = {

# This is triggered on left clicking a cell at r, c
ms_start_new_game = {
    # initialize
    set_variable = { name = ms_game value = 1 }

    # mark r,c temporarily as 0
    set_variable = { name = value_$r$_$c$ value = 0 }

    # generate mines and board
    ms_generate_board = { r = $r$ c = $c$ }

    # mark r,c back to comp value
    set_variable = { name = value_$r$_$c$ value = root.var:comp_$r$_$c$ }

    # if initial click is 0, propagate
    ms_propagate_uncover = yes

    # recompute visuals
    ms_recompute_visuals = yes
}

ms_lose_game = {
    # Lose the game
    set_variable = { name = ms_game value = 2 }
    
    # Display all bombs
    if = {
        limit = { AND = { var:comp_0_0 = { compare_value = 10 } var:value_0_0 = { compare_value = 12 } } }
        set_variable = { name = value_0_0 value = 10 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { AND = { var:comp_0_1 = { compare_value = 10 } var:value_0_1 = { compare_value = 12 } } }
        set_variable = { name = value_0_1 value = 10 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { AND = { var:comp_0_2 = { compare_value = 10 } var:value_0_2 = { compare_value = 12 } } }
        set_variable = { name = value_0_2 value = 10 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { AND = { var:comp_0_3 = { compare_value = 10 } var:value_0_3 = { compare_value = 12 } } }
        set_variable = { name = value_0_3 value = 10 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { AND = { var:comp_0_4 = { compare_value = 10 } var:value_0_4 = { compare_value = 12 } } }
        set_variable = { name = value_0_4 value = 10 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { AND = { var:comp_0_5 = { compare_value = 10 } var:value_0_5 = { compare_value = 12 } } }
        set_variable = { name = value_0_5 value = 10 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { AND = { var:comp_0_6 = { compare_value = 10 } var:value_0_6 = { compare_value = 12 } } }
        set_variable = { name = value_0_6 value = 10 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { AND = { var:comp_0_7 = { compare_value = 10 } var:value_0_7 = { compare_value = 12 } } }
        set_variable = { name = value_0_7 value = 10 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { AND = { var:comp_0_8 = { compare_value = 10 } var:value_0_8 = { compare_value = 12 } } }
        set_variable = { name = value_0_8 value = 10 }
    }

#   go over every cell
#   if any cell has a 0 neighbor, uncover that cell and incr counter
#   while counter != 0

            if = { limit = { var:value_14_29 = { compare_value = 10 } } set_variable = { name = value_14_29 value = 9 } change_variable = { name = ms_loss_counter add = 1 } }
            if = { limit = { var:value_15_27 = { compare_value = 10 } } set_variable = { name = value_15_27 value = 9 } change_variable = { name = ms_loss_counter add = 1 } }
            if = { limit = { var:value_15_29 = { compare_value = 10 } } set_variable = { name = value_15_29 value = 9 } change_variable = { name = ms_loss_counter add = 1 } }

            if = {
                limit = {
                    var:ms_loss_counter = { compare_value > 0 }
                }
                ms_lose_game = yes
            }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { AND = { var:ms_t_cr = { compare_value = 15 } var:ms_t_cc = { compare_value = 29 } var:value_15_29 = { compare_value > 0 } var:value_15_29 = { compare_value <= 8 } } }
        set_variable = { name = ms_flag_counter value = 0 }
        if = { limit = { var:value_14_29 = { compare_value = 11 } } change_variable = { name = ms_flag_counter add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { var:value_14_28 = { compare_value = 11 } } change_variable = { name = ms_flag_counter add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { var:value_15_28 = { compare_value = 11 } } change_variable = { name = ms_flag_counter add = 1 } }
        if = {
            limit = { var:ms_flag_counter = { compare_value = root.var:value_15_29 } }
            if = { limit = { var:value_14_29 = { compare_value = 12 } } set_variable = { name = value_14_29 value = var:comp_14_29 } }
            if = { limit = { var:value_14_28 = { compare_value = 12 } } set_variable = { name = value_14_28 value = var:comp_14_28 } }
            if = { limit = { var:value_15_28 = { compare_value = 12 } } set_variable = { name = value_15_28 value = var:comp_15_28 } }
            set_variable = { name = ms_loss_counter value = 0 }
            if = { limit = { var:value_14_29 = { compare_value = 10 } } set_variable = { name = value_14_29 value = 9 } change_variable = { name = ms_loss_counter add = 1 } }
            if = { limit = { var:value_14_28 = { compare_value = 10 } } set_variable = { name = value_14_28 value = 9 } change_variable = { name = ms_loss_counter add = 1 } }
            if = { limit = { var:value_15_28 = { compare_value = 10 } } set_variable = { name = value_15_28 value = 9 } change_variable = { name = ms_loss_counter add = 1 } }

            if = {
                limit = {
                    var:ms_loss_counter = { compare_value > 0 }
                }
                ms_lose_game = yes
            }
        }
    }

    # if the game isnt lost, propagate 0 and recompute visual
    if = {
        limit = { var:ms_game = { compare_value = 1 } }
        ms_propagate_uncover = yes
        ms_recompute_visuals = yes
    }
}
